edit-page.addASharedToolSkillKnowledge: Add a shared tool, skill, knowledge or memory file from its shelf.
edit-page.everyWorkspaceCanReadItNone: Every {@workspace.one} can read it; none overrides it.
edit-page.sharedWithEveryWorkspaceInThis: Shared with every {@workspace.one} in this account. Agents reach these files at ../../../../library/.

files-page.createAWorkspaceOrAddA: Create a {@workspace.one}, or add a shared tool or skill that every {@workspace.one} can use.
files-page.theWholeAccountAsOneTree: The whole account as one tree: {length} files as they sit on disk, minus the platform's own bookkeeping. Add or remove under <link>each shelf</link> or in a {@workspace.one}.
files-page.thisFileIsOnDiskAnd: This file is on disk and listed here, but its contents are not served: {sealed}

gallery-drift.installedFromTheGalleryAndIdentical: Installed from the gallery, and identical to the version the platform ships now
gallery-drift.installedFromTheGalleryButNot: Installed from the gallery, but not identical to the version the platform ships now — either the gallery moved on, or this copy was edited
gallery-drift.replaceThisCopyWithTheGallery: Replace this copy with the gallery's current version. The previous content stays one revision back.

page.aNearerFileOfTheSame: A nearer file of the same name runs there instead of this one.
page.capabilitiesInTheOpenAgentSkills: Capabilities in the open Agent Skills format, available to every {@workspace.one} in this account.
page.codeThatScriptToolsRunMounted: Code that script tools run, mounted as library/'<'file'>'. A file here is not a capability until a tool points at it.
page.everyAgentInEveryWorkspaceOf: Every agent in every {@workspace.one} of this account — the nearest file of the same name wins.
page.noAgentHasGrantedItWith: No agent has granted it with tools: yet.
page.referenceMaterialYouGiveAgentsSpecs: Reference material you give agents — specs, price lists, brand guidelines. Read, never rewritten.
page.rotateACredentialItUsesAnd: Rotate a credential it uses and exactly these agents are affected.
page.whatAgentsHaveLearnedSharedAcross: What agents have learned, shared across {@workspace.other}. One fact per file; the index is generated.
page.whatAnAgentCanDoAn: What an agent can do — an API, a script, or an MCP server. One definition, granted by name with `tools: [name]`.
page.yourOwnCodeAtEveryTool: Your own code at every tool call, step start or step end, on every model — one folder each, hook.md beside run.mjs. Turned on by name with `hooks: [name]`, or for every agent from an AGENTS.md.
